viewer: People in their 50s buying long-term care insurance they may not use for 20 years, choosing between a 3% and a 5% compound inflation option.
decision: Is the 3% compound inflation option enough, or is the pricier 5% option worth paying for?
promise: We run the 3% and 5% options through every 20-year stretch of nursing home prices on record to see how each kept pace.
title: Long-Term Care Insurance: 3% or 5% Inflation Protection?
thumbnail: Nursing home room with a daily price tag climbing stairs / "3% or 5%?"
